summary: The gyomu-ai-compiler package provides compilation pipelines for AI-driven code analysis and documentation generation. It defines data schemas, execution contexts, and renderers for updating Python docstrings and analyzing package and directory concepts.
responsibilities: Provide compilation pipelines for generating AI-driven documentation and package concept analysis.
Define data models and schemas for tracking declaration contexts, file contexts, and AI update plans.
Manage prompt templates and configurations for AI interactions within the compiler framework.

capabilities.name: Docstring Generation and Updates
capabilities.description: Defines structured schemas and execution plans for deterministic AI-driven code docstring updates, including replacement actions, parameter changes, raises, and returns.

capabilities.name: Package and Directory Analysis
capabilities.description: Processes package-level and directory-level concepts, synthesizing public API symbols, dependencies, and code structure into structured inputs and analysis summaries.

capabilities.name: Prompt Management
capabilities.description: Manages and loads prompt templates and base configurations to drive AI compilation tasks.

design_decisions: Utilizes structured schemas to enforce deterministic AI plans and actions for code documentation modifications.
Organizes compiler logic into modular, pipeline-specific execution contexts and renderers.
usage_guidance: Use the docstring update pipeline executors and schemas to parse, evaluate, and apply deterministic AI-driven documentation changes to Python codebases.
Leverage the package concept and directory analysis pipelines to extract public APIs, dependencies, and structural summaries for package exploration.
